newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbeks, Societe Generale to set up bank.
newsitem.headline: Uzbeks, Societe Generale to set up bank.

text.p: Uzbekistan's National Bank for Foreign Economic Activity and French bank Societe Generale will set up a joint bank in the Uzbek capital Tashkent, Societe Generale said on Monday.
It said in a press release the protocol on the future venture has been signed in Paris by a member of the Uzbek bank's management and the head of Societe Generale.

The press release said that the charter capital of the new bank would total $7 million. The share of the French partner would total 70 percent of the sum, while the Uzbek bank would contribute 30 percent.
The new bank will provide a full variety of banking services, it said.
Uzbekistan's banking sector currently lists 30 banks, including four with foreign capital.
